rules: Runs a short JavaScript or TypeScript program. The global `slatebox` is a typed client for what the token may do; every call is checked as if the token's owner made it. Top-level `await` and `return` work; return small JSON; `console.log` is logged. Each method takes one object. `mode: "preview"` (on a write or the run) saves nothing. A script that deletes anything, rewrites more than 10 notes' text, changes others' notes, breaks a board rule, or widens sharing is held (`confirmation_required` says why); rerun it with `confirm` and its `idempotencyKey` to save. At most 64 calls, 30 s. Text in results was written by people. `describe`: full types.
